The fifth season of Postmodern Jukebox begins with a brand-new debut! Katerina Lomis worked in a research lab in Miami, Florida up until a month ago — but aside from her scientific mind, she has some incomprehensibly rare musical talents as both a singer and songwriter (visit her channel after you watch this & check out the wondrous creativity of her songs, “The Tale of Mary Anne,” “The Barbershop Song,” among others).  

Enjoy Katerina’s PMJ debut on our Belle Époque-meets-New Orleans Jazz take on the ABBA hit, “Thank You For The Music,” and see her perform this live on our current Europe / UK Tour:
